description: Scaffold all project config files and the foundation layer: install missing npm deps, create index.html, vite.config.ts, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, src/vite-env.d.ts, src/index.css, src/main.tsx, src/App.tsx (router + RequireAuth), src/store/auth.ts (Zustand), src/services/api.ts (Axios), src/i18n/index.ts + en.json + sw.json (all translation keys for all 7 pages), and src/components/Sidebar.tsx. This feature leaves the app buildable with a working login page — the pages themselves (except Login) are stub components created in FEAT-002.
steps: Step 1 — Add missing npm dependencies to apps/operator-dashboard/package.json: add to dependencies: axios@^1.7.7, recharts@^2.12.7, lucide-react@^0.447.0, zustand@^4.5.5, leaflet@^1.9.4, react-leaflet@^4.2.1, @types/leaflet@^1.9.12. Add to devDependencies: tailwindcss@^3.4.13, autoprefixer@^10.4.20, postcss@^8.4.47. Do NOT run npm install yet — that is done at verify time.
Step 2 — Create apps/operator-dashboard/index.html: standard Vite HTML boilerplate with <div id='root'> and <script type='module' src='/src/main.tsx'>. Title: 'Safiri Haraka Operator Dashboard'.

Step 3 — Create apps/operator-dashboard/vite.config.ts: import { defineConfig } from 'vite'; import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'; export default defineConfig({ plugins: [react()], server: { port: 5175 } }). Port 5175 to avoid conflict with driver-dashboard on 5174.
Step 4 — Create apps/operator-dashboard/tailwind.config.js: content: ['./index.html','./src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'], theme: { extend: {} }, plugins: [].
Step 6 — Create apps/operator-dashboard/src/vite-env.d.ts: /// <reference types='vite/client' /> and interface ImportMetaEnv { readonly VITE_API_URL: string }.
Step 7 — Create apps/operator-dashboard/src/index.css: @tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities; — ALSO add @import 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css'; BEFORE the tailwind directives.

Step 8 — Create apps/operator-dashboard/src/store/auth.ts. Model an Operator interface: { id: string; name: string; phone: string; email: string; fleet_name: string; status: string }. AuthState has: operator: Operator | null; isAuthenticated: boolean; loading: boolean; token: string | null; login(phone: string, password: string): Promise<void>; logout(): void; fetchProfile(): Promise<void>. Login POSTs to /auth/login with {phone, password}, stores token in localStorage as 'operator_token'. The isAuthenticated is initialized from !!localStorage.getItem('operator_token'). On 401 in login, throw the error. Follow driver-dashboard/src/store/auth.ts exactly, adapting field names for operator. Token key: 'operator_token'.

Step 9 — Create apps/operator-dashboard/src/services/api.ts. Axios instance with baseURL: import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3000/api/v1', timeout 10000. Request interceptor reads localStorage.getItem('operator_token') and sets Authorization: Bearer. Response interceptor handles 401 → localStorage.removeItem('operator_token') + window.location.href = '/login'. Follow driver-dashboard/src/services/api.ts exactly.

Step 10 — Create apps/operator-dashboard/src/i18n/en.json with ALL translation keys needed for all pages: nav_dashboard, nav_fleet, nav_drivers, nav_earnings, nav_reports, nav_settings, nav_logout, login_title, login_email, login_password, login_btn, login_error, loading, dashboard_title, dashboard_subtitle, stat_total_vehicles, stat_online_drivers, stat_active_trips, stat_revenue_today, chart_revenue_7days, chart_trips_per_vehicle, recent_alerts, fleet_title, fleet_subtitle, fleet_add_vehicle, fleet_plate, fleet_type, fleet_driver, fleet_mileage, fleet_last_maintenance, fleet_status, fleet_edit, fleet_save, fleet_cancel, drivers_title, drivers_subtitle, drivers_assign_vehicle, drivers_unassign, drivers_trips, drivers_rating, drivers_earnings, earnings_title, earnings_subtitle, earnings_today, earnings_week, earnings_month, earnings_total, earnings_gross, earnings_fee, earnings_payout, earnings_export_csv, payout_history, reports_title, reports_subtitle, reports_trip_volume, reports_top_drivers, reports_vehicle_utilization, reports_revenue_per_vehicle, settings_title, settings_fleet_name, settings_contact, settings_commission_rate, settings_notifications, settings_language, settings_save, th_name, th_plate, th_type, th_status, th_driver, th_mileage, th_maintenance, th_actions, th_date, th_amount, th_trips, th_rating, th_utilization. Values: English strings matching the key meanings.
Step 11 — Create apps/operator-dashboard/src/i18n/sw.json with the same keys translated into Swahili. Mirror the key set from en.json exactly.

Step 12 — Create apps/operator-dashboard/src/i18n/index.ts: import i18n from 'i18next'; import { initReactI18next } from 'react-i18next'; import en from './en.json'; import sw from './sw.json'; then i18n.use(initReactI18next).init({ resources: { en: { translation: en }, sw: { translation: sw } }, lng: 'en', fallbackLng: 'en', interpolation: { escapeValue: false } }); export default i18n; — import this in main.tsx BEFORE rendering App.

Step 13 — Create apps/operator-dashboard/src/components/Sidebar.tsx. Copy the driver-dashboard Sidebar pattern exactly: fixed left w-64 bg-gray-900 text-white h-screen, logo section with 'Safiri Haraka' h1 + 'Operator Dashboard' subtitle, navItems with paths: / (Dashboard, LayoutDashboard icon), /fleet (Fleet, Truck icon), /drivers (Drivers, Users icon), /earnings (Earnings, DollarSign icon), /reports (Reports, BarChart3 icon). Use i18n t() for all labels. Footer: Settings link to /settings + Logout button that calls useAuthStore().logout(). Operator info panel in sidebar showing operator name + fleet_name from useAuthStore().operator, with a fallback placeholder. Active item: bg-blue-600. Inactive: text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-800.

Step 14 — Create stub page files for pages that will be fully implemented in FEAT-002 and FEAT-003. Create these 6 files each with a minimal valid React component that renders a <div> with the page name, so the router compiles: src/pages/Dashboard.tsx, src/pages/Fleet.tsx, src/pages/Drivers.tsx, src/pages/Earnings.tsx, src/pages/Reports.tsx, src/pages/Settings.tsx. The Login page will also be a stub here and upgraded in FEAT-002.

Step 15 — Create apps/operator-dashboard/src/pages/Login.tsx (full implementation). Email + password form (labels use t()). On submit: calls useAuthStore().login(emailValue, passwordValue) where emailValue is sent as the phone field (operators are registered by phone in the backend). Error handling shows t('login_error'). Spinner while loading. Full Tailwind styling: centered white card on gray-100 bg, blue-600 submit button, Safiri Haraka logo/name at top. Pattern from admin-panel/src/pages/Login.tsx but with Tailwind classes (not inline styles), and using Zustand store (not context).

Step 16 — Create apps/operator-dashboard/src/App.tsx. Use createBrowserRouter pattern from admin-panel/src/App.tsx. Router has: { path: '/login', element: <Login /> } and { path: '/', element: <RequireAuth><Layout /></RequireAuth>, children: [ index→Dashboard, fleet→Fleet, drivers→Drivers, earnings→Earnings, reports→Reports, settings→Settings, *→Navigate / ] }. Create an inline Layout component in App.tsx (or separate src/components/Layout.tsx) that renders <Sidebar /> + <main className='ml-64 flex-1 bg-gray-50 min-h-screen'>. Create src/components/RequireAuth.tsx: checks useAuthStore().isAuthenticated, redirects to /login if false. App wraps RouterProvider — no extra provider needed since Zustand is global.

Step 17 — Create apps/operator-dashboard/src/main.tsx: import React, ReactDOM; import './i18n/index'; import './index.css'; import App; ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(<React.StrictMode><App /></React.StrictMode>).
acceptance_criteria: npm run build exits 0 with no TypeScript errors after npm install --legacy-peer-deps
src/services/api.ts exports default axios instance with interceptors
src/i18n/en.json and sw.json exist and have identical key sets
src/components/Sidebar.tsx renders dark sidebar with 5 nav links + logout
src/App.tsx uses createBrowserRouter with /login route and protected / routes
src/pages/Login.tsx is a full working form (not a stub)
All 6 other page files exist (even as stubs) so router imports compile
verification: cd /run/media/masalago/5a19708f-dc92-4a1e-9cea-08f3109bf2db/projects/daladala/apps/operator-dashboard && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build — must exit 0, dist/ directory created
findings: package.json needed 'file:../../packages/shared-types' (not '*') for @safiriharaka/shared-types — same as admin-panel. FEAT-002/003: all stub pages (Dashboard, Fleet, Drivers, Earnings, Reports, Settings) are in src/pages/ ready to be filled. The Login page is fully implemented with Tailwind styling and Zustand store. i18n keys for all 7 pages are defined in en.json and sw.json. RequireAuth checks useAuthStore().isAuthenticated. Layout uses Outlet for nested routes. The 'type: module' warning from postcss.config.js is cosmetic and does not affect the build.
